text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH--!!)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
I was spacing out while walking...!
I'll help you pick up your things!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, don't worry about it!
I wasn't paying attention either—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? This box...
Is the structure kinda strange? ...Ah!!)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Fuji... To think I ended up seeing
the trick for your upcoming magic show... I'm really sorry.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I won't tell anyone, of course...!
And... so nothing goes wrong,
maybe it's better if I don't go near the show...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No, leaving you out of the fun?
I could never do that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Instead—I have an even better idea!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!!
Welcome to the "Kiseki Magic Show"!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Welcome...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaa Fuji-senpaaaai!!
...Wait, isn't that Miracle-san?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's rare...! I thought she wasn't the type
to step into the spotlight, but...
Wait, this is great! I like it! Totally into this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today we have a special edition featuring
a very reliable little assistant♪
And next—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, the Trainer just passing by!
Would you care to step up onto the stage?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone, direct your attention to this box!
Miracle and Trainer-san here
will now step inside, and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will firmly lock it from the outside.
Maybe I'll wrap some chains around it too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alas, what fate awaits the two of them?!
Witness for yourselves this miraculous great escape!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as explained, I was placed inside the box together
with KS Miracle. The heavy sound of the lock clicking shut
resonating in the darkness felt strangely unsettling...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you... nervous?
...It's okay, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fuji's magic skills really are incredible.
And besides... yeah.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if something does happen,
I'll protect you. ...Always.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that puts me at ease.
No, if something happens, I'll protect you!
No, if something happens, I'll protect you!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if something does happen,
I'll protect you. ...Always.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that puts me at ease.
No, if something happens, I'll protect you!
No, if something happens, I'll protect you!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then, I'm glad.
Fufu...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... if you'd like, do you want to hold hands?
It might make you feel even more at ease—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry.
My hands aren't very warm, after all.
...If you don't mind that, please go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone, count down with me.
...One, two, three!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's supposed to be my role...
...But.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're really cool, Trainer-san.
...I'd like to become like that too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone, count down with me.
...One, two, three!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A spectacular, successful escape!!
Everyone, a round of applause for our wonderful assistant Miracle,
and for Trainer-san who helped us out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAA--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, several more magic tricks were performed by Fuji Kiseki
and KS Miracle, bringing the show to a close with huge success.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Miracle!
That was magnificent support. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really?
If everyone enjoyed it, then I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course they did! You saw it too, didn't you?
Just how delighted everyone who gathered was.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, would you want to do it with me again?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I wonder.
I'd feel terrible if I ended up holding you back.
I'm really not used to this kind of thing at all...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But didn't you feel that it was 'fun', too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When you felt that we pulled off an extraordinary show!
Back when you were on stage, surrounded by everyone's
sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Miracle. Listen, keep this in mind.
'For the sake of others' is important too. But—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's okay for you to cherish your own
desire of wanting to try things out, you know.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fuji...
